versions.changelog: Setup now triggers immediately on install/first load, not just on first command. Stronger MANDATORY wording to ensure Agent guides user through config.
1. Setup guide: warn user to use sub-account API key for safety; 2. TG config now optional - auto-discovers bot token from OpenClaw + chat_id via getUpdates fallback
Fix: rename config.yaml.example to config.example.yaml to avoid gitignore filtering
Fix: include config.yaml.example in package; Add first-time setup guide in SKILL.md

Initial release of Binance Trade Hunter skill.

- Analyze crypto coins and market trends via Telegram commands.
- Buy or sell coins on Binance with one-click commands.
- Monitor positions, balances, and receive instant pump alerts.
- Run background services for pump detection and scheduled coin updates.
- Easy setup with auto Telegram bot integration; configurable for custom bots.
- Supports both Chinese and English trigger keywords for all major commands.
